objective: Separate search-result exposure from click-through performance and measure English, French and Swahili changes against stable route cohorts.

evidenceBoundary.englishBaseline: data/seo/gsc-recovery-waves.json contains a checked-in seven-route English baseline.
evidenceBoundary.localizedBaseline: No granular French or Swahili query/page export is checked in. Do not claim CTR recovery for either locale until the required export is captured.
evidenceBoundary.staticAudit: reports/search-snippet-quality.json covers every current indexable canonical English, French and Swahili HTML route.

auditResult.reviewCandidateMeaning: Length and differentiation heuristics for manual review; these rows are not missing-metadata or indexability errors.

falseFrenchIframeParity.reason: These routes rendered an English tool in an iframe and therefore were not native French equivalents despite being discoverable as French pages.

en.action: Preserved the seven-route measured recovery cohort while repairing source-owned export-document, insurance, legal, workforce, agriculture, car-catalogue, directory, AfroKitchen and AfroAtlas search contracts; retired three redirect shells and one duplicate remittance workflow from the indexable denominator.

fr.action: Replaced English and generic country-page snippets with distinct French task and country wording, repaired car-catalogue, solar, tool-gap and Sports families, retired false iframe parity, and retired two duplicate search routes.

sw.action: Repaired employment-country snippets, removed generic English task wording, differentiated competing task titles, expanded thin descriptions, added static headings where client rendering previously hid them, and retired one duplicate remittance route.

sourceOwnedSnippetWaves.countingNote: These are governed page touches, not a deduplicated changed-page total; families can overlap when a page needed more than one contract repair.

windows.label: indexing-check
windows.purpose: Confirm selected canonical URLs and rendered snippets without judging CTR recovery.

windows.label: primary-review
windows.purpose: Compare matched 28-day page and query cohorts by locale.

windows.label: durability-review
windows.purpose: Check whether gains persist and whether pages need consolidation or deeper native-content work.

measurement.comparisonRule: Use equal pre/post windows, keep locale and device cohorts separate, and inspect query mix before attributing a CTR change to copy.
measurement.decisionRule: Prioritize pages with meaningful impressions and stable positions. A position or query-mix change is not a clean snippet-copy result.
